country.name: Democratic Republic of the Congo
country.jurisdictionNotice: National, provincial and educational-province responsibilities must be preserved. Preschool, primary, secondary, technical and vocational education and higher education have distinct authorities and records.
country.languagePolicy: French and Lingala, Kiswahili, Kikongo ya leta and Tshiluba have distinct official, national, instructional and community roles. Language, province, curriculum approval and community context must be preserved.

review.policy: No category becomes verified without a named qualified Congolese reviewer and current authoritative evidence from the competent national ministry, educational province, regulator or institution.

governanceModel.summary: MINEDU-NC governs preschool, primary, secondary and technical education nationally, with administration distributed through provinces and educational provinces. The ministry responsible for higher education governs institutions and programs in that subsector.
governanceModel.schoolRule: Preserve province, educational province, territory or commune, official identifier, management network, level, sector, approval, operating status and observation year. Statistical enumeration is not live authorization.
governanceModel.higherEducationRule: Institution viability or authorization, exact program authorization, diploma authority, quality status, professional recognition and regional recognition are separate claims.

authorities.name: Ministry of National Education and New Citizenship (MINEDU-NC)
authorities.role: preschool, primary, secondary, technical and vocational school education

authorities.name: General Inspectorate of Education
authorities.role: inspection and verification of state diplomas, certificates and school records within its mandate

authorities.name: Education information-management and statistics services
authorities.role: national and provincial census, school map and annual statistics

authorities.name: Provincial and educational-province authorities
authorities.role: territorial school administration, approval and record validation

authorities.name: Competent curriculum directorates and inspectorates
authorities.role: official programs, frameworks, textbooks and implementation instruments

authorities.name: Ministry responsible for Higher and University Education
authorities.role: higher-education institution, program and diploma oversight

authorities.name: Personal-data protection authority established under the Digital Code
authorities.role: personal-data supervision within the statutory mandate

authorities.name: Competent child-protection and justice authorities
authorities.role: implementation of the Child Protection Law and safeguarding referrals

curriculum.title: Official national programs and curriculum orientation framework
curriculum.implementationRule: A curriculum orientation framework, program library, reform announcement or teacher resource is not proof that every listed document controls every class in 2026. Verify the exact cycle, grade, option, subject, language, approving instrument, version and effective year.
curriculum.supplementPolicy: Framework, program, option curriculum, implementing order, examination reference, textbook, teacher guide and external resource are separate layers.

schoolDirectory.authority: MINEDU-NC and responsible provincial or educational-province authority
schoolDirectory.scopeNotice: The 2023 private-school reference announcement and 2023–2024 yearbook do not together prove a current unified directory of every public and private school. Verify the exact identifier, management network, approval, educational province and current viability.
requiredRecordFields: observation year, source and review date

educationStatistics.scopeNotice: The yearbook was published in October 2026 but its data describe school year 2023–2024. Preserve observation year separately from validation and publication dates, together with province, educational province, level, sector, definition and denominator.

vocationalQualifications.authority: MINEDU-NC and other competent technical, vocational and professional authorities within exact mandates
vocationalQualifications.authorityNotice: School approval, technical option, occupational standard, examination authority, qualification and award authority are separate claims. Verify provider, site, option or program, modality, decision and validity.

higherEducation.authority: Ministry responsible for Higher and University Education
higherEducation.authorityNotice: An institution list or viability declaration does not authorize every program, campus, modality or award. Verify institution act, current viability, exact program authorization, diploma authority, site, modality, validity and any professional or regional recognition separately.

privacyAndSafeguarding.dataProtectionLaw: Ordinance-Law No. 23/010 of 13 March 2023 establishing the Digital Code
privacyAndSafeguarding.childrenLaw: Law No. 09/001 of 10 January 2009 relating to child protection
privacyAndSafeguarding.scopeNotice: Confirm the operational data-protection authority, implementing procedures, legal basis, sensitive and biometric data, learner rights, transfers, security, retention and incidents. Current education-sector reporting, referral, disability inclusion, displaced-learner protection, consent and emergency procedures must be approved before a real learner pilot.

culturalAndLanguageRequirements.rule: French and Lingala, Kiswahili, Kikongo ya leta and Tshiluba must retain distinct curriculum, instructional and community roles. Province, language variety, orthography, bilingual transition, Indigenous and displaced-community context require exact review. Automatic translation is not localization.

completionCriteria: A qualified Congolese education reviewer is named.
National, provincial, educational-province and higher-education responsibilities are correctly assigned.
A verified current unified all-school directory is documented or the gap remains visible.
Every statistic preserves 2023–2024 observation year separately from 2026 publication date.
Every curriculum record preserves cycle, grade, option, subject, language, instrument, version and effective year.
Every school and higher-education claim separately verifies authorization, program or option, award, site, status and validity.
Data-protection authority and implementation procedures are verified.
Child safeguarding and displaced-learner procedures are approved before a real learner pilot.
French and national-language resources preserve their distinct provincial and community contexts.
